title: Profiling and Benchmarks
---

# Benchmarks

[CodSpeed](https://codspeed.io/) runs the benchmarks under `benchmarks/` in CI. Run them locally with:

```bash
python -m pytest benchmarks/ --codspeed
```

Add a benchmark for substantial new behavior and investigate reported regressions before merging.

# Profiling

Profile a specific benchmark with `pytest-profiling`, then inspect the generated `.prof` file with [SnakeViz](https://jiffyclub.github.io/snakeviz/):

```bash
pip install snakeviz
pytest benchmarks/test_patch_benchmarks.py::TestProcessingBenchmarks::test_pass_filter --profile
snakeviz prof/test_pass_filter_performance.prof
```
